events.event_name: NEST New York Cardamom Latte Café
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, W 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW fragrance launch café for NEST New York's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, combining fragrance discovery with a complimentary Cardamom Latte drink.
events.what_is_free: Public entry and a complimentary Cardamom Latte are advertised while supplies last. The fragrance can be sampled at the activation; purchasing the Sephora-exclusive perfume is optional.
events.caveats: Complimentary lattes are while supplies last. Current event sources agree on September 14, 10 AM–9 PM at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. No RSVP or approval requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation on Monday, September 14 from 10 AM–9 PM, or until latte supply runs out. Arrive earlier if the complimentary drink is the main draw.

events.event_name: The Nitro Bar × Reese's Pumpkins Pop-Up
events.address: Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: The Nitro Bar's first NYC pop-up, created with Reese's around a limited-time Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte and Halloween-themed giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised per day, each with a recipe card and Reese's Pumpkins candy. The first 100 guests each day can receive a limited-edition Reese's × The Nitro Bar koozie; additional cooler surprises are also advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: The official Hershey/Reese's release confirms the NYC pop-up on September 14–15. Current NYC event listings place it at Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Place, starting at 11 AM. Promotional drinks and giveaways are quantity-limited and may end before the nominal closing time.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation September 14 and 15. Use 11 AM–5 PM as the advertised operating window, but treat the end time as subject to supplies running out; arrive early for the latte or first-100 koozie.

events.event_name: Fashion Designers of Latin America — The Life of Giannina Azar
events.address: United Palace, 4140 Broadway, New York, NY 10033
events.what_it_is: A free immersive runway showcase by Dominican designer Giannina Azar with 50 models moving through the theatre and a live performance by pianist Maria Del Sol.
events.what_is_free: Admission is complimentary with RSVP/ticket registration.
events.caveats: United Palace's ticketing calendar confirms doors at 6 PM and show at 7 PM on September 14. Complimentary admission requires registration; no organizer-approval language is published in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Doors 6 PM, show 7 PM, programmed through roughly 9 PM. Register through the United Palace ticket page before traveling.
